name: Coil
tagline: Wrap a trail around the orbs before they burst. Best score lives in the file.
description:
Drag a glowing trail with a finger or the mouse. Loop it around the blue orbs before they explode. Close a loop around more than one and the multiplier climbs. Red ones are bombs — do not wrap those.

On a phone the trail is your thumb. On a computer it is the mouse. There is no account and nothing leaves this file.

An unofficial port of Coil by Hakim El Hattab, MIT-licensed.
